FlightControlPanel.restartMissionFromTheFirstWaypoint: Restart mission from the first waypoint
FlightControlPanel.forceArmBypassesPreArmSafety: Force ARM bypasses pre-arm safety checks
FlightControlPanel.dismissTheseACheckThatS: Dismiss these. A check that's still failing reappears when the flight controller re-reports it.
FlightControlPanel.missionNotUploadedToTheVehicle: Mission not uploaded to the vehicle yet
FlightControlPanel.bypassPreArmChecksUseOnly: Bypass pre-arm checks. Use only when the failing check is known-safe.
FlightControlPanel.waypointsHasNotBeenUploadedTo: waypoints) has not been uploaded to the flight controller, so starting AUTO now would not fly it.
FlightControlPanel.armModeNotConfiguredClickBelow: ARM mode not configured. Click below to auto-configure for SITL testing.

JoystickPanel.plugInAGamepadAndPress: Plug in a gamepad and press a button so the browser sees it, or a handset in USB Joystick mode, or use the on-screen sticks below
JoystickPanel.everythingBelowIsSwitchedOffUntil: Everything below is switched off until this is on
JoystickPanel.theBrowserForcedThisDeviceInto: The browser forced this device into the console-pad layout, which hides every axis past the first four. Switches will not be assignable.
JoystickPanel.theOnScreenSticksDoNot: The on-screen sticks do not use this mapping: they go to the channels the vehicle names in RCMAP_ROLL / PITCH / THROTTLE / YAW. The bars below still show what is being sent.
JoystickPanel.whereTheStickPositionsComeFrom: Where the stick positions come from, instead of a physical gamepad. Throttle holds where you leave it; the right stick springs back. Both centre if the window loses focus.
JoystickPanel.turnJoystickInputOnAboveTo: Turn joystick input on above to use these.
JoystickPanel.vehicleFliesOnItsOwnReceiver: Vehicle flies on its own receiver
JoystickPanel.framesSStopSendingAndThe: {{vehicleFps}} frames/s · stop sending and the vehicle returns to its receiver within a second
JoystickPanel.turnJoystickInputOnAboveFirst: Turn joystick input on above first.
JoystickPanel.pickAnInputFirstConnectA: Pick an input first: connect a gamepad or switch on the on-screen sticks.
JoystickPanel.sendsYourSticksToTheVehicle: Sends your sticks to the vehicle. Only the channels you assigned are sent; everything else stays with the receiver.
JoystickPanel.armedTheSticksAreLiveThis: Armed. The sticks are live: this window must keep focus, because a browser stops reporting the controller when it does not have it.

MapPanel.splitTheMapWithAnotherPanel: Split the map with another panel
MapPanel.dragToResizeOrUseThe: Drag to resize, or use the X to close the split
MapPanel.switchTheInstrumentsToALayout: Switch the instruments to a layout sized for the half-width map?
MapPanel.largeMissionShowingKeyWaypointsLaunch: Large mission: showing key waypoints (launch, turns, landing) and the live target. The full flight path is still drawn.
MapPanel.theSplitCockpitLayoutASaved: The split cockpit layout (a saved layout named "split" wins)
MapPanel.keepWhatIsOnScreenAs: Keep what is on screen as the split layout
MapPanel.leaveTheLayoutAsItIs: Leave the layout as it is
MapPanel.noVehicleSelectedClickAVehicle: No vehicle selected: click a vehicle marker before commanding.
MapPanel.mapCommandsNeedAnArmedVehicle: Map commands need an armed vehicle.

ModuleMapLayers.doubleClickTheMapOrEnter: Double click the map, or Enter

NtripPanel.theMultiVehicleEngineRunsThe: The multi-vehicle engine runs the NTRIP client and injects corrections into every vehicle
NtripPanel.thisDesktopRunsTheNtripClient: This desktop runs the NTRIP client and injects into the connected vehicle
NtripPanel.correctionsFromABaseReceiverPlugged: Corrections from a base receiver plugged into this computer. Works fully offline.
NtripPanel.rescanSerialPortsPortsUsedBy: Rescan serial ports. Ports used by an active vehicle connection are not listed.
NtripPanel.theReceiverMustBeConfiguredAs: The receiver must be configured as a base (surveyed-in or fixed position) and output RTCM3 on this port.
NtripPanel.ntripRevisionAutoTriesV2And: NTRIP revision. Auto tries v2 and falls back to v1
NtripPanel.uploadsTheVehicleSGpsPosition: Uploads the vehicle's GPS position as NMEA GGA. Required by VRS / network mountpoints.
NtripPanel.isAMountpointNotACaster: "{{host}}" is a mountpoint, not a caster host. Put the caster server name in Host and "{{host}}" in Mountpoint.

SafetyMonitorPanel.setTheRollPitchBitsOf: Set the roll+pitch bits of GCS_PID_MASK so the FC streams PID_TUNING
SafetyMonitorPanel.armedOnTheGroundTipOver: Armed & on the ground - tip-over watch active
SafetyMonitorPanel.replayARecordedTlogThroughThe: Replay a recorded .tlog through the monitor
SafetyMonitorPanel.groundStateInferredNoExtendedSys: Ground state inferred (no EXTENDED_SYS_STATE on this link).

SitlStatusPanel.fcNotReceivingGcsValuesCheck: FC not receiving GCS values. Check:

takeoff_strategies.armSwitchToGuidedClimbVertically: Arm, switch to GUIDED, climb vertically (NAV_TAKEOFF)
takeoff_strategies.setTkoffAltSwitchToTakeoff: Set TKOFF_ALT, switch to TAKEOFF mode, hand-launch / runway
takeoff_strategies.planeGoesIntoTakeoffModeNeeds: Plane goes into TAKEOFF mode. Needs hand-launch, runway, or catapult to start the roll.
takeoff_strategies.armInQstabilizeSwitchToGuided: Arm in QSTABILIZE, switch to GUIDED with Q_GUIDED_MODE, hover up (NAV_VTOL_TAKEOFF)
takeoff_strategies.hoversUpUsingQModesNav: Hovers up using Q-modes (NAV_VTOL_TAKEOFF). Forward-flight transition is manual after.
takeoff_strategies.subDoesNotUseATakeoff: Sub does not use a takeoff command
takeoff_strategies.waitingForGpsEkfSFix: Waiting for GPS/EKF ({{waited}}s): fix={{fixType}} sats={{satellites}} hdop={{v4}}
takeoff_strategies.planeTakeoffMisconfiguredNoTakeoffMode: Plane takeoff misconfigured: no TAKEOFF mode set
takeoff_strategies.didNotReachVehicleStillArmed: Did not reach {{v1}}: vehicle still armed in QHover, take RC control
